description: Test file for Kubernetes GCE COS configuration helper, including test case setup, file copying, environment script creation, and pod manifest loading.

classes.name: ManifestTestCase
classes.description: Struct for testing Kubernetes manifest configuration, including methods for setup, file copying, environment script creation, and cleanup.

methods.name: newManifestTestCase
methods.description: Initializes a new test case, setting up directories and copying necessary files.

methods.name: mustCopyFromTemplate
methods.description: Copies the main manifest template file to the source directory.

methods.name: mustCopyAuxFromTemplate
methods.description: Copies auxiliary manifest files to the source directory.

methods.name: mustCreateManifestDstDir
methods.description: Creates the destination directory for the manifest.

methods.name: mustInvokeFunc
methods.description: Runs the specified function within a bash environment, sourcing environment scripts and auxiliary scripts.

methods.name: mustCreateEnv
methods.description: Creates an environment script from templates with provided environment data.

methods.name: mustLoadPodFromManifest
methods.description: Reads and decodes the pod manifest into the test case's pod object.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Removes all files and directories created during the test case.
